posts.title: From Software to Software Engineering: Abstractions
posts.description: Recently I wrote down my thoughts about how Software Engineering, as a true engineering discipline, was really only just beginning. I also opined that, as Software Engineers, we have an opportunity to do something other engineering disciplines cannot: remove the gap between design and implementation.

posts.title: Software Engineering Is Not Over; It’s Only Just Beginning
